package.description: Coordinate multiple CLI coding agents in isolated workspaces.

en-US.description: Coordinate multiple CLI coding agents in isolated workspaces.
en-US.longDescription:
AgentsCommander is a desktop application for running and coordinating multiple CLI coding agents.
It provides terminal sessions, teams, isolated room workspaces, and file-based communication between agents.
en-US.name: Agents Commander
